Gentle diffuse elevation, refined corner radii, meticulous spacing, Inter-like UI typography, JetBrains Mono-like utility labels. Avoid ornamental glass everywhere, decorative maritime pictures, neon, dark dashboard, marketing hero, oversized metrics, fake probability scores, retraining/model comparison panels, maps.

Show reporting coverage, sparse/no reporting, sensor evidence, semantic log matching, and an investigation workflow. Sparse reports alone do not imply failure. Distinguish reported issue, routine maintenance, and candidate blindspot. All numbers/chart values are illustrative mock content, no claimed performance lift. Use clear usable controls, text and status labels rather than color alone. One chosen case: Bay Pioneer, Bearing 02, recurring vibration with few captain reports. Never show 'confirmed failure' without verification. Copy should be short and specific.
